description: The facts of the archive of the supplementary suite, which mise.toml declares (http:jsontestsuite) and mise.lock pins by sha256: its case count and the digest of its inputs, so a record that names the suite can be checked without it. The PIE release, its PHAR hash and the revision of the suite are those of mise.toml. Update the facts when the archive changes, with the same review as a source change.
